manifest.transform: Remove Markdown title, page delimiters, attribution and explicitly pinned editorial footers after attribution from model text; join otherwise unedited page bodies with blank lines and one final newline. Preserve internal line breaks, source spelling and story notes. Preserve attribution separately; no images, audio or model-generated text.
limitations: A modest reading expansion, not broad world knowledge or instruction tuning. More text alone has not been shown to repair the model.
Internal line breaks, occasional grammatical defects, original spellings, verse and notes remain. No silent rewriting or invented credits.
Some works contain folklore, figurative language, simplified causes or historical claims. They are reading material, not independently verified factual instruction.
Both text files and the English index come from one repository; their agreement is not independent verification against current publisher PDFs.

Exact whole-text, normalized paragraphs of at least 120 characters and normalized 20-word overlap checks miss paraphrases and shorter shared phrases. Related 0057 was separately excluded, and 0144/0146 and 0005/0006 are each kept within training.
Tests are reserved for future final evaluation. Reading source files for exclusion checks is not model scoring.
No training schedule, early stopping rule, age promotion or population reproduction policy is changed by preparation.

starter.limits: Exact document checks only; no semantic overlap or curriculum mastery assessment.

broader.limits: Exact document checks only; no semantic overlap or curriculum mastery assessment.

protocol.learning_math: Inherited TF32 and ordered gradient reductions; native shared forward path.
protocol.assessment_math: Strict FP32, reset at each 128-target window and exact short tail; no updates.
protocol.source_order: Starter ten whole stories first; broader appends 34 whole training stories in selected order. Sequential cycles.
protocol.state_policy: Complete native resume and append-only admission retain weights, Adam, recurrence, speech RNG and replay history.
protocol.primary_comparison: Broader versus starter after 546 observations, separately for replay every 4 and every 1. Broader sees 67188 new targets once; starter sees 66704 targets with repetition. This is not exact equal-byte exposure.
protocol.continuation_comparison: After 1092 observations: two complete broader passes versus about 9.4 starter passes. No checkpoint chosen by assessment score.

gate.required_seeds: all three, evaluated separately per replay cadence

protocol.generation: Two fixed 384-byte story continuations and seven-round 512-byte decode at final endpoints; all six prior question prompts on all twelve final models, 192 bytes each, no retries.
protocol.timing: Sequential GPU runs, condition order reversed on alternating seeds. Live segment time includes replay, speech, logging and saves; excludes startup and assessment. Different short tails and replay selections prevent pure compute or hardware claims.
protocol.limits: Content identity, breadth and repetition change together; one order and three related ancestors. Shared development probes and same-source creators limit generalization. Passing is a candidate result, not general conversation or lifelong learning.
